**Exploring the Geometric Buchberger Algorithm in Integer Programming Gabriel Mattos Langeloh gmlangeloh@inf.ufrgs.br**

*Instituto de Informatica, Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul*

8 pp, 12 sections.

**Abstract.** The Geometric Buchberger algorithm is a specialization of the clas- sical Buchberger algorithm to the case of toric ideals, with applica- tions in the solution of families of integer programming problems. In this paper, we investigate the performance of the Geometric Buchberger algorithm in a variety of combinatorial optimization problems with both integer and binary variables, introducing algo- rithmic improvements for the latter case in the form of an efficient criterion for detecting S-binomials that can be truncated away. Our experiments show that our implementation, available in the package IPGBs.jl, computes Grébner bases for toric ideals of combi- natorial optimization problems more efficiently than the previous state-of-the-art. ACM Reference Format: Gabriel Mattos Langeloh. 2024. Exploring the Geometric Buchberger Al- gorithm in Integer Programming.

**Outline.** Abstract; 1 INTRODUCTION; 2 BACKGROUND; 3 THE BINARY CASE; 4 EXPERIMENTAL RESULTS; 4.1 Experimental setup; 4.2 Evaluating the binary case; 4.3 IPGBs performance; 4.4 Computing group relaxations; 5 CONCLUSION; Acknowledgments; References
